intro.title: LAST ASSEMBLY
intro.subtitle: You know what's sleeping in the vault. You always did.
body: The complex went cold the night the machines turned. What is
left of the town shelters in its depths, down near the core.
You are working inward to wake it. Section by section, because
the vault at the centre only answers a machine that is whole,
and the thing asleep in there is what let the swarm off its
leash. Take it back and the swarm stops.
There was never enough scrap for all of it. Send teams out for
the rest. Wake only what the grid can carry — and every machine
you leave cold, the town pays for in people.

steps.title: Start with what's nearest
steps.body: The Scrap Converter by the core still turns. Repair it — the way inward runs through every machine between here and the vault.

steps.title: Give it power
steps.body: A repaired machine is still a dead one until it draws. Power it, and the section behind it wakes with it.

steps.title: Cover the route
steps.body: A Ballistic Turret and Laser Emitter still guard the intake. Tap EMP Pylon, then tap a lit pad to add a third tower.

steps.title: Raise the beacon
steps.body: The scrap is out there, not in here. START BEACON sends the teams — and tells the swarm exactly where you are.
